an5.31:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an5.31:1.2: Atha kho Sumanā rājakumārī pañcahi rathasatehi pañcahi rājakumārisatehi parivutā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Sumanā rājakumārī Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.31:2.1: Idh' assu bhante Bhagavato dve sāvakā samasaddhā samasīlā samapaññā
an5.31:2.3: te kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjeyyuṃ,
an5.31:2.4: devabhūtānaṃ pana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇan ti?
an5.31:3.2: Yo so Sumane dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ devabhūto samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an5.31:3.3: dibbena āyunā, dibbena vaṇṇena, dibbena sukhena, dibbena yasena, dibbena adhipateyyena.
an5.31:3.4: Yo so Sumane dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ devabhūto samāno imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti. 4.
an5.31:4.1: Sace pana te bhante tato cutā itthattaṃ āgacchanti, manussabhūtānaṃ pana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇan ti?
an5.31:4.3: Yo so Sumane dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ manussabhūto samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an5.31:4.4: mānusakena āyunā, mānusakena vaṇṇena, mānusakena sukhena, mānusakena yasena, mānusakena adhipateyyena.
an5.31:4.5: Yo so Sumane dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ manussabhūto samāno imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti. 6.
an5.31:5.1: Sace pana te bhante ubho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, pabbajitānaṃ pana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇan ti?
an5.31:5.3: Yo so Sumane dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ pabbajito samāno pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti:
an5.31:5.4: yācito 'va bahulaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito, yācito 'va bahulaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito, yācito 'va bahulaṃ senāsanaṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito, yācito 'va bahulaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito.
an5.31:5.5: Yehi kho pana sabrahmacārīhi saddhiṃ viharati, tyassa manāpen'eva bahulaṃ kāyakammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, manāpen'eva bahulaṃ vacīkammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, manāpen' eva bahulaṃ manokammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, manāpaṃ yeva upahāraṃ upaharanti appaṃ amanāpaṃ.
an5.31:5.6: Yo so Sumane dāyako so amuṃ adāyakaṃ pabbajito samāno imehi pañcahi ṭhānehi adhigaṇhāti. 8.
an5.31:6.1: Sace pana te bhante ubho arahattaṃ pāpuṇanti, arahattappattānaṃ pana nesaṃ bhante siyā viseso siyā nānākaraṇan ti? 9.
an5.31:6.2: Ettha kho pan' esāhaṃ Sumane na kiñci nānākaraṇaṃ vadāmi yad idaṃ vimuttiyā vimuttin ti. 10.
an5.31:7.2: yāvañ c' idaṃ bhante alam eva dānāni dātuṃ, alaṃ puññāni kātuṃ,
an5.31:7.3: yatra hi nāma devabhūtassa pi upakārāni puññāni, manussabhūtassa pi upakārāni puññāni, pabbajitassa pi upakārāni puññānī ti.
an5.31:7.5: evam etaṃ Sumane, alaṃ hi Sumane dānāni dātuṃ, alaṃ puññāni kātuṃ,
an5.31:7.6: devabhūtassa pi upakārāni puññāni, manussabhūtassa pi upakārāni puññāni, pabbajitassa pi upakārāni puññānī ti.
an5.31:8.2: idaṃ vatvā Sugato, athāparaṃ etad avoca Satthā:
